1.e4 e6 2.d4 d5 3.Qe2 e5 4.f4.strategy: Attacks e5 a second time, and Black's pawn has no defender, so Black must act at once. White offers the f-pawn: if Black takes it, the e-pawn captures on d5 with check and the queen on e2 looks down the open e-file at the king.

1.e4 e6 2.d4 d5 3.Qe2 e5 4.f4 exf4.strategy: Grabs a pawn that falls straight back: White takes on d5 with check along the open e-file, and Black's king stays in the centre with the f4 pawn hanging to the bishop. Black ends a pawn down and behind in development.
1.e4 e6 2.d4 d5 3.Qe2 e5 4.f4 exf4.name: French Defence: Hoffmann Gambit
